items.quote: let fire come out from Abimelek and consume you, the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo, and let fire come out from you, the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo, and consume Abimelek!
items.contrast: The failed-good-faith condition leads to mutual destruction, not the mutual joy associated with acting honorably.
items.reason: The window explicitly assigns mutual joy to “If you have” acted honorably, but reciprocal consuming fire to “if you have not.” The reader must distinguish the two conditions and recognize that Abimelek and the citizens are both agents and targets of the destruction.
